title: Croatian Namul Gallette
description: A flavorful vegetarian dish combining the crunch of namul with the savory taste of croatian gallette. This recipe is perfect for those looking for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Roll out the Croatian gallette to the desired thickness.
Spread the namul evenly over the gallette, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Top the namul with thinly sliced onions.
Sprinkle the seasoned croatian breadcrumbs over the onions.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the gallette from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the gallette into desired portions and serve hot.
